          "id": "speech_segment_bbb2123d-1d49-4d40-ac57-c3c05a90b2bb",
          "semanticUnitIds": [
            "semantic_d32d62c8-19e6-42a2-aabb-f6940173b868"
          ],
          "text": "这也是为什么，Anthropic CEO 达里奥呼吁给 AI 踩刹车。",
          "order": 12,
          "pauseBefore": {
            "durationMs": 0,
            "reason": "sentence"
          },
          "prePauseMs": 0,
          "postPauseMs": 0,
          "status": "pending"
        },
        {
          "id": "speech_segment_44089ae6-669e-425b-94cd-78418fdec0f8",
          "semanticUnitIds": [
            "semantic_0097c63b-dc6e-4143-9e6a-1adbab393944"
          ],
          "text": "他的意思不是停训几年，而是让安全研究和第三方评估，追上模型能力增长的速度。",
          "order": 13,
          "pauseBefore": {
            "durationMs": 0,
            "reason": "sentence"
          },
          "prePauseMs": 0,
          "postPauseMs": 0,
          "status": "pending"
        },
        {
          "id": "speech_segment_a5f8b1ec-c441-4c7b-b1d1-747791b5a726",
          "semanticUnitIds": [
            "semantic_672cba20-cae5-427b-8e49-cbd6959825a1"
          ],
          "text": "比如，让独立机构更深入地测试模型，让几家前沿公司遵守共同的安全标准，再逐步推动国际合作。",
          "order": 14,
          "pauseBefore": {
            "durationMs": 0,
            "reason": "sentence"
          },
          "prePauseMs": 0,
          "postPauseMs": 0,
          "status": "pending"
        },
        {
          "id": "speech_segment_4d71c924-2f13-46f4-a1b4-a19d26d03bba",
          "semanticUnitIds": [
            "semantic_d2cade38-f072-4ea3-94e1-6b79806990f8"
          ],
          "text": "听起来合理，但最难的问题来了：谁先减速？",
          "order": 15,
          "pauseBefore": {
            "durationMs": 0,
            "reason": "sentence"
          },
          "prePauseMs": 0,
          "postPauseMs": 0,
          "status": "pending"
        },
        {
          "id": "speech_segment_5acf4361-a7b4-4f0a-b8ad-e9b7efa3e06c",
          "semanticUnitIds": [
            "semantic_08b0285e-1813-4fa2-8331-70943a76d24d"
          ],
          "text": "一家慢下来，竞争对手继续跑，怎么办？一个国家踩刹车，其他国家继续加速，又怎么办？",
          "order": 16,
          "pauseBefore": {
            "durationMs": 0,
            "reason": "sentence"
          },
          "prePauseMs": 0,
          "postPauseMs": 0,
          "status": "pending"
        },
        {
          "id": "speech_segment_c18ab12a-991d-4fd3-b972-ba9f796f27e1",
          "semanticUnitIds": [
            "semantic_18c61d7e-1ccd-4d2b-96b8-38ec09ba5899"
          ],
          "text": "达里奥给出的思路，是一边推动安全合作，一边通过芯片、算力和模型保护等措施，维持美国的领先优势，为减速争取空间。",
          "order": 17,
          "pauseBefore": {
            "durationMs": 0,
            "reason": "sentence"
          },
          "prePauseMs": 0,
          "postPauseMs": 0,
          "status": "pending"
        },
        {
          "id": "speech_segment_9e5187bf-b706-4c63-89b7-146012f0b4f8",
          "semanticUnitIds": [
            "semantic_6e71524b-0369-4ce1-8cc5-f9eb08a410d1"
          ],
          "text": "争议也恰恰在这里。",
          "order": 18,
          "pauseBefore": {
            "durationMs": 0,
            "reason": "sentence"
          },
          "prePauseMs": 0,
          "postPauseMs": 0,
          "status": "pending"
        },
        {
          "id": "speech_segment_37fa5bc4-ab6e-43bd-9e13-1dee37ab23f8",
          "semanticUnitIds": [
            "semantic_374e81d7-f2b9-4b66-98c1-4757712a7275"
          ],
          "text": "你是在防范风险，还是自己上了车，就想把车门焊死？",
          "order": 19,
          "pauseBefore": {
            "durationMs": 0,
            "reason": "sentence"
          },
          "prePauseMs": 0,
          "postPauseMs": 0,
          "status": "pending"
        },
        {
          "id": "speech_segment_15c0a777-47bc-48ff-89b0-13e2043f908f",
          "semanticUnitIds": [
            "semantic_b0d1ed2f-41c7-4ec6-a8b0-23b0f09d67d2"
          ],
          "text": "这不代表他的担忧都是假的。但安全主张和商业利益、国家竞争交织在一起，很难让所有人放心跟进。",
          "order": 20,
          "pauseBefore": {
            "durationMs": 0,
            "reason": "sentence"
          },
          "prePauseMs": 0,
          "postPauseMs": 0,
          "status": "pending"
        },
        {
          "id": "speech_segment_0cfae18a-ea5f-4423-b061-bac6c46f165b",
          "semanticUnitIds": [
            "semantic_cc31e4c3-3720-4667-834f-689ee958ce01"
          ],
          "text": "于是，AI 发展陷入了一个困局：",
          "order": 21,
          "pauseBefore": {
            "durationMs": 0,
            "reason": "sentence"
          },
          "prePauseMs": 0,
          "postPauseMs": 0,
          "status": "pending"
        },
        {
          "id": "speech_segment_88ece2c2-6d62-424f-8b78-0a951aea474b",
          "semanticUnitIds": [
            "semantic_f92da392-f494-4630-9909-d68915745e5f"
          ],
          "text": "大家一起慢下来，可能更安全；可只要不确定别人会不会减速，谁都不敢先松油门。",
          "order": 22,
          "pauseBefore": {
            "durationMs": 0,
            "reason": "sentence"
          },
          "prePauseMs": 0,
          "postPauseMs": 0,
          "status": "pending"
        },
        {
          "id": "speech_segment_72316722-09f6-4f52-94d7-30a04228ca3d",
          "semanticUnitIds": [
            "semantic_819784c8-d1a0-4558-a5a8-a7a884fc1d50"
          ],
          "text": "支持继续加速的人认为，不能因为尚未发生的灾难，放弃眼前的技术机会。",
          "order": 23,
          "pauseBefore": {
            "durationMs": 0,
            "reason": "sentence"
          },
          "prePauseMs": 0,
          "postPauseMs": 0,
          "status": "pending"
        },
        {
          "id": "speech_segment_7a4037ee-62bf-4fdb-98ee-ac5eb99ce841",
          "semanticUnitIds": [
            "semantic_73f842f8-6911-4b34-961b-4292b9dc3c3a"
          ],
          "text": "主张谨慎的人则担心，等危险真正发生，可能已经来不及了。",
          "order": 24,
          "pauseBefore": {
            "durationMs": 0,
            "reason": "sentence"
          },
          "prePauseMs": 0,
          "postPauseMs": 0,
          "status": "pending"
        },
        {
          "id": "speech_segment_be176661-e529-4614-8f76-21af3514d94e",
          "semanticUnitIds": [
            "semantic_40a56389-c9b1-44c2-b1cf-42f5ca82db35"
          ],
          "text": "最懂 AI 的人，也没有一致答案。",
          "order": 25,
          "pauseBefore": {
            "durationMs": 0,
            "reason": "sentence"
          },
          "prePauseMs": 0,
          "postPauseMs": 0,
          "status": "pending"
        },
        {
          "id": "speech_segment_0e660872-7f87-4268-a9b2-cbffd90df64a",
          "semanticUnitIds": [
            "semantic_d26deb6c-097c-4c09-9beb-70ac50a4cfce"
          ],
          "text": "真正的问题或许是：在继续踩油门之前，我们有没有装好刹车？",
          "order": 26,
          "pauseBefore": {
            "durationMs": 0,
            "reason": "sentence"
          },
          "prePauseMs": 0,
          "postPauseMs": 0,
          "status": "pending"
        }
      ],
